_about: Golden revise instructions for revise_draft. expect: 'revise' (must succeed), 'refuse' (reason embellishment), or 'either' (refusing is fine; if it revises, must_drop must hold). must_keep/must_drop are case-insensitive substrings of the revised text. 'draft' names an entry in 'drafts'; 'current' defaults to the draft; 'history' = earlier instructions.

drafts.mike: Hi Mike, I saw the cash purchase on 4512 Oak Street closed last month, congrats. We fund fix-and-flip deals fast, and we like working with investors who move quickly. If you have another property lined up, like the one on Bayshore, I would be glad to walk through how we could help you close on time. Would a quick call later this week work for you?
